eyebrow: SYSTEMS ARCHITECTURE · QUANTITATIVE ML · AI CONTEXT GOVERNANCE
headline: Three private R&D systems, unpacked down to the data contracts, validation loops, and ML pipelines.
subheadline: Commercial real-estate intelligence, quantitative time-series research, and proprietary design systems rarely ship as open-source repos. This showcase bridges that gap: explore the interactive architecture, animated execution flows, and sanitized JSON contracts behind Property Intelligence, Oracle & Wave Y (Trade Bot), and GÜELGA.
